name: FlatBars
_doc: FlatBars TextMate fallback — modeled on Shopify's ERB grammar shape and split
by SEMANTIC ROLE of every emitted span:
ESCAPE TOKEN — it opens or closes an embedded FlatBars context. They all carry
`punctuation.section.embedded.{begin,end}.flatbars`, so themes that paint ERB /
PHP / Vue embedded delimiters paint FlatBars identically.
The SIGIL-WITH-IDENTIFIER that distinguishes control tags is captured SEPARATELY
from the brace cluster and carries `keyword.control.*.flatbars`:
{{#name}}  →  {{  +  #name   →  keyword.control.section
{{/name}}  →  {{  +  /name   →  keyword.control.section
{{^name}}  →  {{  +  ^name   →  keyword.control.section
{{<name}}  →  {{  +  <       →  keyword.control.inheritance
{{$name}}  →  {{  +  $       →  keyword.control.inheritance
{{>name}}  →  {{  +  >       →  keyword.control.import
{{=A B=}}  →  {{  +  =  …  =  +  }}   →  keyword.directive
Every tag region carries `meta.embedded.{line,block}.flatbars`. Inner content
(identifiers, paths, args after the sigil) is default-coloured at the floor; the
LSP corrects in-tag literals, operators, `{{else}}` / `{{elif}}` keywords, and
dialect-disallowed errors via semantic tokens (see token-vocabulary.json
`lspEmitKinds`).
check:tmgrammar pins the engine ↔ grammar agreement on tag boundaries per dialect.
check:vocab pins every vocabulary tmScope exists below.

handlebars._doc: Dispatch order matters: longer / more specific patterns first.

repository.//interior: ════════════════ TAG INTERIOR — included from every expression-bearing tag ════════════════

tag_interior._doc: The pattern set every expression-bearing tag includes inside its region. Covers the lexical pieces shared across all FlatBars dialects: quoted strings, numeric literals, boolean/null constants, operators (FullBars `as |x|` / MaxBars infix + pipe), subexpression parens, list-literal brackets, and path separators (`.` / `/` for nested paths). Stateless: cannot distinguish first-position helper names from later-position arguments — that's the LSP's job. The LSP's semantic tokens override these where they overlap.

tag_constant._doc: true / false / null literals — the three language constants supported across all FlatBars dialects. Word-boundary anchored so identifiers like `truely`/`nullable`/`falsey` aren't false-matched.
tag_constant.name: constant.language.flatbars

tag_operator._doc: MaxBars infix + pipe + nullish coalescing. Multi-char operators MUST come before single-char so `==`/`!=`/`<=`/`>=`/`??`/`&&`/`||`/`<-` aren't split.
tag_operator.name: keyword.operator.flatbars

tag_bracket._doc: MaxBars list-literal brackets (ADR-025) and Handlebars `[seg.with.dot]` path segments.
tag_bracket.name: punctuation.section.brackets.flatbars

raw_block._doc: {{{{ … }}}} … {{{{/ … }}}} — quad-brace raw block. Accepts both Handlebars's bare form ({{{{name}}}}) and the FlatBars-native hash form ({{{{#name}}}}). The whole name span — including the optional `#` sigil on the open and the mandatory `/` on the close — is captured as `keyword.control.section`, so the block name reads visually as a control keyword (mirroring how {{#each}} / {{/each}} are captured at the double-brace level). The `\w` at the start of the begin's name capture keeps it from matching the close form (which starts with `/`).
raw_block.name: meta.embedded.block.flatbars

comment_long._doc: {{!-- … --}} — body may contain }} that do NOT terminate the comment.
comment_long.name: comment.block.flatbars

triple_stash._doc: {{{ … }}} — raw triple-stash. Must precede #variable so triple braces match before double.
triple_stash.name: meta.embedded.line.flatbars

amp_unescaped._doc: {{& … }} — Mustache-style raw alias for triple-stash. Split like the control tags: the `{{` and `}}` are escape tokens (embedded), the `&` is a raw-output sigil pulled out as `keyword.operator.raw`.
amp_unescaped.name: meta.embedded.line.flatbars

variable._doc: {{ … }} — escape-by-default interpolation. Catch-all; negative lookahead excludes every sigil already handled.
variable.name: meta.embedded.line.flatbars

repository.//control: ════════════════ CONTROL TAGS — braces SPLIT from sigil+identifier ════════════════

block_open._doc: {{#name …}} — block helper open. The braces are escape tokens; the `#name` sigil-and-identifier is a control keyword.
block_open.name: meta.embedded.line.flatbars

block_close._doc: {{/name}} — block close. The braces are escape tokens; `/name` is a control keyword.
block_close.name: meta.embedded.line.flatbars

inheritance_parent._doc: {{<parent}} — Mustache inheritance parent. The `<` sigil alone is the control keyword.
inheritance_parent.name: meta.embedded.line.flatbars

inheritance_block._doc: {{$name}} — Mustache inheritance block declaration. The `$` sigil alone is the control keyword.
inheritance_block.name: meta.embedded.line.flatbars

partial._doc: {{>name}} / {{>*name}} — partial include. The `>` (or `>*`) sigil alone is the control keyword.
partial.name: meta.embedded.line.flatbars

set_delimiter._doc: {{=A B=}} — set-delimiter directive. Both `=` sigils are matched-pair directive keywords; the braces are escape tokens.
set_delimiter.name: meta.embedded.line.flatbars
